scripts.ios: npm run build:ios && npm run cap:sync:production && npm run cap:open
scripts.ios:dev: DMC_APP_FLAVOR=dev CAP_DEV_SERVER=http://$(scutil --get LocalHostName).local:5173 npx cap sync ios && npm run cap:open
scripts.ios:staging: npm run build:ios:staging && npm run cap:sync:staging && npm run cap:open
scripts.ios:production: npm run build:ios:production && npm run cap:sync:production && npm run cap:open
scripts.ios:install:dev: set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App-Dev -configuration Debug -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -derivedDataPath build-dev -allowProvisioningUpdates build && xcrun devicectl device install app --device "$IPHONE_UDID" build-dev/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/App.app
scripts.ios:install:staging: set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App-Staging -configuration Staging -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -derivedDataPath build-staging -allowProvisioningUpdates build && xcrun devicectl device install app --device "$IPHONE_UDID" build-staging/Build/Products/Staging-iphoneos/App.app
scripts.ios:install:production: set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App-Production -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -derivedDataPath build -allowProvisioningUpdates build && xcrun devicectl device install app --device "$IPHONE_UDID" build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/App.app
scripts.ios:deploy:dev: npm run build:ios:dev && npm run cap:sync:dev && npm run ios:install:dev
scripts.ios:deploy:dev:offline: npm run build:ios:dev:offline && npm run cap:sync:dev && npm run ios:install:dev
scripts.ios:deploy:staging: npm run build:ios:staging && npm run cap:sync:staging && npm run ios:install:staging
scripts.ios:deploy:production: npm run build:ios:production && npm run cap:sync:production && npm run ios:install:production
scripts.ios:deploy: npm run build:ios && npm run cap:sync:production && npm run ios:install:production
scripts.test:worker: vitest run --config worker/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config worker/vitest.http.config.ts
scripts.worker:lifecycle:staging: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle set dmc-captures-staging --file worker/lifecycle.json --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.worker:lifecycle:production: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle set dmc-captures --file worker/lifecycle.json --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --env production
